lb-1czv.title: Publish breaststroke demo on tailnet
lb-1czv.description: Goal: make the built BioLife breaststroke demo reachable only from the machine's Tailscale tailnet. Context: the browser demo is available at ?demo=breaststroke and Tailscale CLI 1.98.2 is installed, but tailscaled was not running at discovery time. Requirements: preserve any existing Tailscale Serve config; build the app; serve the static dist output from localhost with a repeatable repo command; expose that local origin through Tailscale Serve rather than Funnel; verify the tailnet HTTPS URL and demo route. Acceptance: a tailnet peer can load the demo URL, the endpoint is not public internet/Funnel, and README documents start/status/stop operations. Out of scope: public hosting, Tailscale account enrollment changes without explicit need, system-wide unrelated services, and genome work.

lb-354f.title: Encode and inherit evolvable locomotion gaits
lb-354f.description: Goal: make successful locomotion selectable across generations. Context: src/creature.ts currently randomizes actuation amplitude, frequency, and phase at instantiation, so offspring do not inherit a gait. Requirements: after the canonical swimmer validates the physics, define gait parameters in the genome, include them in parsing/serialization/mutation/crossover as appropriate, and instantiate links deterministically from inherited genes. Acceptance: offspring preserve an unmutated parent's gait, mutations are bounded, and deterministic tests cover inheritance. Out of scope: new node types, fitness objectives, mating balance, and UI.

lb-cxhk.title: Add visible canonical breaststroke demo
lb-cxhk.description: Goal: let a person watch the exact validated breaststroke swimmer in the browser. Context: commit 8f00cab defines the stroke only in a headless CommonJS fixture; src/main.ts still exposes the obsolete timer-driven C-key fish. Requirements: move the canonical swimmer and simulation-time stroke definition into a browser-importable src module used by both tests and UI; add an isolated, clearly documented browser demo mode with useful framing and forward-displacement feedback; preserve the existing ecosystem default. Acceptance: the browser demo uses the same implementation as test/breaststroke.test.cjs, npm test and npm run build pass, and README gives the exact demo URL/control. Out of scope: genome inheritance, ecosystem balance, new rendering art, and unrelated debug cleanup.

lb-dwgb.title: Implement canonical breaststroke locomotion constraint
lb-dwgb.description: Goal: prove positive, directed propulsion with a deterministic pre-programmed swimmer. Context: build on the headless harness from lb-oe6z and the acceptance criteria in .trapper_keeper/pages/biolife-simulation.md. Requirements: define a symmetric two-degree-of-freedom breaststroke shape loop driven entirely by simulation time; assert body-relative shape closure, positive forward displacement, bounded lateral drift/yaw, repeatable per-cycle travel, reversed travel for a reversed loop, and timestep convergence. Acceptance: the canonical swimmer passes deterministically under the corrected drag model and the command is documented. Out of scope: genome encoding, random creatures, rendering/UI, and ecosystem balance.

lb-oe6z.title: Add deterministic physics harness and negative controls
lb-oe6z.description: Goal: make basic drag correctness executable and reproducible. Context: src/physics.ts applies forces directly and rotational endpoint signs currently amplify angular velocity; src/main.ts contains non-deterministic console-based experiments. Requirements: add a headless test command with no browser/renderer dependency; test that a passive rotating link loses angular velocity monotonically, a symmetric rest state stays symmetric, and a reciprocal one-degree-of-freedom stroke has negligible net displacement; correct the minimal physics defects needed for these tests; remove obsolete physics debug logging if safely covered. Acceptance: npm test (or the added documented test command), npm run build, and the deterministic controls pass repeatedly. Out of scope: canonical breaststroke positive case, gait inheritance, ecosystem tuning, and renderer changes.

lb-q2d7.title: Establish validated drag-based locomotion
lb-q2d7.description: Goal: make BioLife locomotion demonstrably correct under a coherent drag model. Context: src/physics.ts currently contains rotational anti-damping and unverified timestep/order behavior; the wiki records the agreed constraints. Requirements: establish deterministic headless validation, a canonical breaststroke swimmer, and only then reconnect evolvable gait parameters. Acceptance: passive and reciprocal negative controls pass, the canonical swimmer advances repeatably with bounded drift/yaw and timestep convergence, and locomotion can later be inherited. Out of scope: unrelated ecosystem balance, mating, rendering, and collision changes.
